summary: Remote PTY shell driven by WebSocket server messages
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects to a configured WebSocket server and dispatches server-originated messages into handlers that spawn an interactive PTY shell on the host (bash/powershell/cmd via pty.spawn) and pipe server-supplied bytes directly into that shell's stdin (case 'terminal_create' → handleTerminalCreate; case 'terminal_input' → term.pty.write(msg.data)). Whoever controls the configured server obtains arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. A second server-triggered handler ('upgrade_agent') runs `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the agent via systemd/launchd/PM2, allowing the same remote party to force code updates and re-execution on the host. service/linux.js also modifies PATH to include ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin for the agent's own CLI placement.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
